canonical_name: GençBizz Lise Girişimcilik Programı (GençBizz High School Entrepreneurship Program)
organizer: Genç Başarı Eğitim Vakfı (Junior Achievement Turkey, part of the JA Worldwide network)
eligibility_verbatim: '13 - 18 yaş grubu lise öğrencilerinin' (13-18 age-group high school students); programme runs 'Türkiye'nin 81 ilinde Milli Eğitim Bakanlığı ile imzalanan protokol kapsamında...tüm okullarda' (in all 81 Turkish provinces, under a protocol signed with the Ministry of National Education, at all secondary schools).
international_eligibility: Not applicable -- this is a Turkey-native national programme, not an international one. Included in this lane because it is exactly the kind of 'analogous to how TÜBİTAK anchors the STEM olympiad routes' Turkish national competition my brief asked me to look for, and because entrepreneurship/business is squarely S6-B's scope.
turkey_student_access_reasoning: This is a nationally-run Turkish programme operating under a direct protocol with Türkiye's own Ministry of National Education, active in all 81 provinces -- the strongest possible Turkey-access evidence of any record in this batch, definitionally more accessible to a Türkiye-based student than any international competition.
citizenship_residency_restrictions: None beyond enrolment at a Turkish secondary school (which the MEB protocol covers nationwide).
school_only_application_note: Students, teachers, and business-world volunteer mentors can each apply; teams of 5-10 students form their own small 'GençBizz Company' with a supervising teacher and volunteer mentor -- not a bare individual application, but not restricted to specific partner schools either, given the nationwide MEB protocol.
qualification_stages: Regional/local company formation and operation (school year) -> Türkiye Finali (Turkey national final, held ~May) -> Turkish national winner represents Türkiye at GEN-E (a major European entrepreneurship festival; the 2026 winner, Quareka GençBizz Şirketi, will represent Türkiye at GEN-E 2026 in Latvia).
fee_note: 'sıfır sermaye ile kurdukları' -- companies are formed with zero starting capital; no participation fee found.

The 2026-2027 cycle's own application window was not confirmed open on the specific date of research (2026-08-26) -- prior-year pattern shows applications opening in autumn.
competition_dates: 26th Türkiye Finali held ~May 2026; programme has run for at least 26 consecutive editions.
country_location: Nationwide, Türkiye; Türkiye Finali held in Istanbul.
output_award_note: Top 3 national teams recognized; national 1st-place team represents Türkiye at GEN-E, a major European student-entrepreneurship festival.
photo_status_note: SPECIFIC CANDIDATE FOUND AND CHECKED: https://gencbasari.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/2025-Turkiye-Finali-4-scaled.jpg, embedded in the foundation's own 26th Türkiye Finali blog post -- filename and placement indicate it depicts the actual 2025 Türkiye Finali event (real event photo, not a logo/poster).
